Turn your screen time addiction into fitness gains! Pushscroll is the revolutionary app that trades pushups for scrolling time - making you look more attractive while breaking your phone addiction.

> The Problem: You're wasting YEARS of your life doomscrolling.
Studies show the average person spends 5-6 hours daily on their phone. That's 10+ years of your life mindlessly scrolling TikTok, Instagram, and social media. Time you'll never get back.

> The Solution: Exercise unlocks screen time.
Pushscroll flips your dopamine addiction on its head. Want to scroll? Do pushups first. One pushup = one minute of app time. It's that simple. You'll build an athletic physique while naturally reducing screen time.

> Real Results Our Users Experience:
- Lost weight and gained muscle from daily pushups
- Reduced screen time by 3-4 hours per day
- Better sleep, focus, and mental clarity
- Replaced social media addiction with fitness habits
- More confidence from looking and feeling better

> KEY FEATURES:

>> Exercise-Based App Timer
- Set time limits on any app
- Unlock minutes through push-ups, squats, lunges, jumping jacks, diamond push-ups, squat holds, and situps
- Can't cheat - we use pose detection to count reps

>> Smart App Blocker
- Block social media and addictive apps
- Screen time control that actually works

>> Guided Workouts
- Bodyweight, weight training, and recovery / stretching in the Fitness tab
- Earn extra app time as you complete them

>> Build the Habit
- Level up step by step through your Journey
- Maintain workout streaks and track your progress
- Unlock collectibles and rewards as you go

>> Apple Health + Widgets
- Earn minutes from your daily steps via Apple Health
- Track your streak from your lock screen and home screen

>> Digital Wellbeing Tools
- Detailed screen time reports
- See how much exercise you've earned
- Set goals and crush them
- Dopamine detox made fun

>> Supportive Community
- Join thousands glowing up together
- Weekly fitness challenges
- Share progress and stay motivated

> Perfect For:
- Anyone struggling with social media addiction
- People who procrastinate with their phone
- Those wanting to get fit but lacking motivation
- Students needing better focus
- Professionals seeking productivity
- Anyone with ADHD struggling with phone distractions

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built an app that makes me exercise to scroll on social media

quotes.text:
Hi HN! After catching myself doomscrolling way too often, I got obsessed with this problem. Everyone talks about it, but real fixes are scarce. So I quit my job to tackle it.

My first attempt was an app that intentionally made social media apps more annoying (https://speedbumpapp.com). It reminded me when I'd been scrolling for too long. But I still had to resist the urge to uninstall it - just like how my brain ignored Apple's Screen Time warnings.

Back at the drawing board, I noticed a pattern: people who don't doomscroll are just too busy for that. When my calendar is filled with friends or sports, I can't waste time on the couch.

This led me to Pushscroll, which helps you replace doomscrolling with exercise. 1 pushup = 1 minute of scrolling allowed. We also detect squats and plank with computer vision (on-device).

It won't fix everything - being bored is an important skill to master. But embracing boredom is the last step in this journey. Pushscroll is as easy to open as social media, and seeing progress is surprisingly motivating. We have a bunch of features planned - it's such a fun idea.

I'd love your feedback and hope it helps you swap some scrolls with reps :)

- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pushscroll-screen-time-gym/id6741765734

- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pushscroll.pushscrollapp
